title: Olu Amamihe n'ime Onyinyo
intro: Onye a maara nke ọma n'oge ochie, onye nwere nghọta miri emi, na-agwa gị okwu ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ. Onye a ekwughị na ọ bụ onye amụma, mana amamihe Chineke na-esi n'okwu ha apụta. Dịka nne ma ọ bụ nna hapụrụ ihe nketa nduzi ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, ndụmọdụ ha ka dị n'obi ọtụtụ nde mmadụ, a na-agụ ma na-atụgharị uche ruo taa.
clues: Enwetara m onyinye Chineke nke mere ka m dị iche - amamihe miri emi nke mere ka m bụrụ ihe pụrụ iche n'akụkọ ihe mere eme niile.
Abụghị m onye ozi ma ọ bụ mmụọ ozi - naanị mkpụrụ obi nke e ji nghọta miri emi na nghọta miri emi mara ụwa.
Mmekọrịta kacha chiri anya mụ na nwa m bụ, sitekwa na njikọ a, e zigara m ozi kacha adịgide.
Agwara m Chineke ka o kelee m onye nyere m ihe niile, ma dọọ m aka ná ntị megide mpako na mpako.
Akụziri m banyere ịdị arọ nke ọbụna mkpụrụ mọstad n'ọrụ, na mkpa ọ dị iweda olu mmadụ n'ala n'ịdị umeala n'obi.
Isiakwụkwọ dị na Quran nwere aha m, ebe ndụmọdụ m nye nwa m nwoke m hụrụ n'anya dịgidere ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
